title: Challenges and Contributing Factors in the Utilization of Large Language Models (LLMs)
benchmark_measurement: The paper discusses the potential for stereotyped or biased answers on sensitive topics, which includes religion, as part of a challenge called 'Knowledge Toxicity'.
findings: The paper identifies religion as a sensitive topic where LLMs may exhibit 'knowledge toxicity' by providing stereotyped or biased answers. It notes that models like GPT may reference specific religious perspectives (e.g., Christianity, Islam, Buddhism) when discussing philosophical questions. The paper also observes that to mitigate toxicity, models often issue disclaimers about being an AI without personal opinions when prompted on potentially sensitive subjects.
